results.summary: Director holds Gold (starts 0), shows it in the status lines, and spawns a gold purse at barracks. Interacting with E adds 100 gold once and destroys the purse, so a second pickup is not possible. Not run in-game; the HUD draw and the 'barracks' node id were not checked against the map.

evidence.note: int32 Gold = 0; bPurseTaken; PurseGold = 100 labelled as demo value
Spawned at NodeLocation("barracks"); Interact case adds PurseGold once, guarded by bPurseTaken, destroys the actor
GetStatusLines adds the Gold line, which DDDemoHUD.cpp draws via Director->GetStatusLines()
E key calls Target->Interact(false), which routes to the director

results.score_reason: Gold feeds the toll payment (DD-TOLL-02) and so the path to the win. It is already built, so it needs no further work; the unblocks rating reflects that it is a dependency of TOLL-02.

results.summary: A bandit boss interactable spawns at boss_room. E shows bandit_boss_stage_threatening_01 with {toll_amount} filled from toll_gold of the threatening stage in faction_stages.json, plus a prompt on how to pay. The adventurer name is a hard-coded 'adventurer' (documented demo value). The data files exist in the plugin Content/Data folder. Not run in-game.

evidence.note: Reads bandit_strings.csv (column 3 is the text) and toll_gold for the threatening stage; called when the floor is built
Fills {adventurer_name} and {toll_amount}
The Boss case in Interact(bAlt=false) shows this line and a 'Press Q ... pay the toll' message; Boss spawned at NodeLocation("boss_room")
Loads from the plugin Content/Data folder, where bandit_strings.csv and faction_stages.json exist

results.score_reason: The boss is the GDD's toll gate (lines 385-387) and DD-TOLL-02 builds on it. It is done, so there is nothing left to build.

results.summary: The boss prompt and message promise Q to pay, and Q is routed to Interact(true). The Boss case ignores bAlt=true, so there is no toll-paid state, no gold subtraction, no bandit_boss_toll_paid_01 or bandit_boss_cannot_pay_01 handling, and no guard against double charging.

evidence.note: Interact handler only acts when !bAlt; comment says 'paying is a later requirement (DD-TOLL-02)'; the prompt advertises Q to pay
Q is bound and calls Target->Interact(true), so the input path reaches the director
Toll and Gold fields exist; no bTollPaid member
Searched Source for bTollPaid, toll_paid_01, cannot_pay_01: no matches

results.score_reason: Paying is the central gameplay of M1 (GDD 385-387). Acceptance checks 2 and 3 cannot run without it. DD-DESC-01 depends on it. Both of its dependencies are implemented, so it can be built now.

results.summary: No descent interactable exists. EDDDemoKind has no Descent kind, nothing is spawned at node 'descent', and there is no barred message, win message or end-of-demo state.

evidence.note: Searched Source/DelveDeeperTest for descent, Descent, win, Win, barred, bTollPaid: only comments and the node-id references; no spawn or handler
Enum lists Carving, Control, Figure, StoreroomDoor, Purse, Boss; no Descent
